title: WordGuessRequest v1
description: The model's other spellings for one word of its answer (ADR 0036). Sent by the keyboard to the engine on the same pipe or service as ConvertRequest; `kind` tells them apart. Swift: ArabiziContracts.WordGuessRequest. Explained in docs/API_CONTRACTS.md.

v.description: Contract version; anything else is rejected.

id.description: Request id (UUID), echoed in the response.

text.description: The message as typed (Latin), as it was converted.

before.description: The model's answer up to the word being fixed; empty for the first word.

count.description: How many guesses to return at most.

deadlineMs.description: How long the caller waits; past it the engine answers with no guesses.
